lamina.name: Health Risk
lamina.description: A frame for disease risk: entered test results and history, the weekly activity dose and fitness from the Daily Activity lamina, risk factors that adapt over weeks of a kept-up plan, placeholder risk models and screening flags. Every model is a placeholder until an expert replaces it.

attribute.name: Age
attribute.description: Age in years.

attribute.name: Sex
attribute.description: 1 for male, 0 for female. Risk models weigh the two differently.

attribute.name: Height
attribute.description: Standing height.

attribute.name: Body mass
attribute.description: Body mass.

attribute.name: Systolic blood pressure
attribute.description: Resting systolic blood pressure, seated.

attribute.name: Diastolic blood pressure
attribute.description: Resting diastolic blood pressure, seated.

attribute.name: Total cholesterol
attribute.description: Total cholesterol from a blood test.

attribute.name: HDL cholesterol
attribute.description: HDL cholesterol from the same blood test.

attribute.name: Fasting glucose
attribute.description: Fasting blood glucose.

attribute.name: Smokes now
attribute.description: 1 if the person smokes now, 0 otherwise.

attribute.name: Diagnosed diabetes
attribute.description: 1 if diabetes has been diagnosed, 0 otherwise.

attribute.name: Takes blood-pressure medicine
attribute.description: 1 if the person takes medicine for blood pressure, 0 otherwise.

attribute.name: Close relative with diabetes
attribute.description: 1 if a parent, brother or sister has diabetes, 0 otherwise.

attribute.name: Takes a heart-rate-lowering medicine
attribute.description: 1 if the person takes a medicine that lowers heart rate, such as a beta blocker; 0 otherwise.

attribute.name: Weekly activity now
attribute.description: The weekly activity dose this person records now: the median week of their recordings, from the Daily Activity lamina.

attribute.name: Weekly activity with the plan
attribute.description: The weekly activity dose the plan would give, projected by the Daily Activity lamina.

attribute.name: Resting heart rate
attribute.description: This person's resting heart rate as their watch reported it, the median day of the same period as the activity habit. From the recordings, not the form.

attribute.name: VO2max
attribute.description: This person's VO2max as their watch estimated it, the median of the same period. An estimate from walks, not a laboratory test. From the recordings, not the form.

attribute.name: Weeks the plan is kept up
attribute.description: How many weeks the plan has been kept up. Zero is today, before any adaptation. The largest value stands for settled: the value each factor tends to.

attribute.name: Fasting glucose: shift per 10 MET-h/week
attribute.description: Placeholder. Once settled, fasting glucose sits this much lower for every 10 MET-h/week a plan adds over the person's habit and keeps up. Replace from a meta-analysis of supervised training trials in adults without diabetes, and state the population it came from.

attribute.name: Fasting glucose: largest shift
attribute.description: Placeholder. However much activity is added or taken away, fasting glucose moves no further than this from its value now.

attribute.name: Fasting glucose: weeks to half the shift
attribute.description: Placeholder. After this many weeks of keeping the plan up, half of the settled shift is reached; after twice as many, three quarters.

attribute.name: Fasting glucose: healthy limit
attribute.description: Placeholder. An improvement never carries fasting glucose past this value, and a value already past it is not moved further, so a healthy value is not projected into an unhealthy extreme.

attribute.name: Systolic blood pressure: shift per 10 MET-h/week
attribute.description: Placeholder. Once settled, systolic blood pressure sits this much lower for every 10 MET-h/week a plan adds over the person's habit and keeps up. Replace from a meta-analysis of aerobic training trials on resting blood pressure, and state the population it came from.

attribute.name: Systolic blood pressure: largest shift

attribute.name: Systolic blood pressure: weeks to half the shift

attribute.name: CVD weight: log age
attribute.description: Placeholder. Weight on the logarithm of age in the cardiovascular score.

attribute.name: CVD weight: log systolic pressure
attribute.description: Placeholder. Weight on the logarithm of systolic blood pressure.

attribute.name: CVD weight: log total cholesterol
attribute.description: Placeholder. Weight on the logarithm of total cholesterol.

attribute.name: CVD weight: log HDL cholesterol
attribute.description: Placeholder. Weight on the logarithm of HDL cholesterol; negative because more HDL goes with lower risk.

attribute.name: CVD weight: smoking
attribute.description: Placeholder. Added to the cardiovascular score for a current smoker.

attribute.name: CVD weight: diabetes
attribute.description: Placeholder. Added to the cardiovascular score for diagnosed diabetes.

attribute.name: CVD weight: blood-pressure medicine
attribute.description: Placeholder. Added to the cardiovascular score for treated blood pressure.

attribute.name: CVD weight: male
attribute.description: Placeholder. Added to the cardiovascular score for a male.

attribute.name: CVD weight: VO2max
attribute.description: Placeholder. Weight on VO2max in the cardiovascular score; negative because a fitter person is at lower risk at the same test results. Replace together with the other weights: fitness is partly how activity lowers pressure and glucose, so an equation that holds both must be fitted with both.

attribute.name: CVD weight: resting heart rate
attribute.description: Placeholder. Weight on resting heart rate in the cardiovascular score; positive because a higher resting rate goes with higher risk.

attribute.name: CVD baseline survival
attribute.description: Placeholder. Share of reference people free of cardiovascular disease over the period.

attribute.name: CVD reference score
attribute.description: Placeholder. The score of the reference person: a 50-year-old woman, systolic 125, total cholesterol 5.2, HDL 1.3, VO2max 30, resting heart rate 70, no other factor.

attribute.name: Diabetes score: constant
attribute.description: Placeholder. Constant of the diabetes score.

attribute.name: Diabetes weight: age
attribute.description: Placeholder. Weight on age.

attribute.name: Diabetes weight: body mass index
attribute.description: Placeholder. Weight on body mass index.

attribute.name: Diabetes weight: fasting glucose
attribute.description: Placeholder. Weight on fasting glucose.

attribute.name: Diabetes weight: family history
attribute.description: Placeholder. Added for a close relative with diabetes.

attribute.name: Diabetes weight: blood-pressure medicine
attribute.description: Placeholder. Added for treated blood pressure.

attribute.name: Diabetes weight: VO2max
attribute.description: Placeholder. Weight on VO2max in the diabetes score; negative because a fitter person is at lower risk at the same test results.

attribute.name: Flag threshold: systolic pressure
attribute.description: Placeholder. Resting systolic pressure at or above which the blood-pressure flag is raised.

attribute.name: Flag threshold: diastolic pressure
attribute.description: Placeholder. Resting diastolic pressure at or above which the blood-pressure flag is raised.

attribute.name: Flag threshold: jump in weekly activity
attribute.description: Placeholder. A plan whose weekly dose exceeds the current dose by this factor raises the jump flag.

attribute.name: Guideline range: lower end
attribute.description: Placeholder. Lower end of the weekly activity range guidance recommends.

attribute.name: Guideline range: upper end
attribute.description: Placeholder. Upper end of the weekly activity range guidance recommends.

function.name: Fasting glucose: adaptation
function.formula: added = dose_planned - dose_current; settled = clamp(per_10 * added / 10, -cap, cap); shift = settled * (1 - 2^(-weeks / weeks_half)); value = glucose_fasting + shift, except that an improvement (a shift in the sign of per_10) never carries the value past limit, and a value already past limit is not improved further
function.inputs: glucose_fasting, dose_current, dose_planned, weeks, glucose_fasting_per_10, glucose_fasting_cap, glucose_fasting_weeks_half, glucose_fasting_limit
function.source: Invented numbers in the shape training trials report: a shift proportional to the activity added, a largest shift, and a delay. Not a published model.
function.description: How far fasting glucose moves when the plan is kept up for the elapsed weeks. Placeholder.

function.name: Body mass index now
function.formula: BMI = mass_kg / (height_cm / 100)^2
function.inputs: mass_kg, height_cm
function.source: Standard definition.
function.description: Body mass over height squared.

function.name: Cardiovascular score now
function.formula: cvd_lp = c_age*ln(age) + c_sbp*ln(sbp) + c_tc*ln(chol_total) + c_hdl*ln(chol_hdl) + c_smoker*smoker + c_diabetes*diabetes + c_treated*bp_treated + c_male*sex_male + c_vo2*vo2max + c_rhr*resting_hr
function.inputs: age, sbp, chol_total, chol_hdl, smoker, diabetes, bp_treated, sex_male, vo2max, resting_hr, c_age, c_sbp, c_tc, c_hdl, c_smoker, c_diabetes, c_treated, c_male, c_vo2, c_rhr
function.source: Invented coefficients in the shape of a survival-model risk equation, with two fitness terms. Not a published equation.
function.description: A weighted sum of the test results, the history and this person's fitness. To be replaced by the equation an expert chooses.

function.name: Cardiovascular risk now
function.formula: cvd_risk = 100 * (1 - cvd_S0 ^ exp(cvd_lp - cvd_lp_ref))
function.inputs: cvd_lp_now, cvd_S0, cvd_lp_ref
function.source: The usual survival form; the baseline survival and reference score are invented.
function.description: Turns the score into a chance over the period.

function.name: Diabetes score now
function.formula: dm_lp = d_0 + d_age*age + d_bmi*BMI + d_glucose*glucose_fasting + d_family*family_diabetes + d_treated*bp_treated + d_vo2*vo2max
function.inputs: age, BMI_now, glucose_fasting, family_diabetes, bp_treated, vo2max, d_0, d_age, d_bmi, d_glucose, d_family, d_treated, d_vo2
function.source: Invented coefficients in the shape of a logistic risk score, with a fitness term. Not a published equation.
function.description: A weighted sum of the test results, the history and this person's fitness. To be replaced by the score an expert chooses.

function.name: Type 2 diabetes risk now
function.formula: dm_risk = 100 / (1 + exp(-dm_lp))
function.inputs: dm_lp_now
function.source: The logistic form.
function.description: Turns the score into a chance over the period.
